summary: The return prints on-spec for layout, but the Tax Due and Tax Rate are never written (only the sheet's preprinted '000'/'0%' show), and schedule rows beyond the printed lines vanish so the paper totals disagree with the data.

defects.where: Page 2 Item 41 Tax Due (and Page 1 Item 18 which copies it)
defects.what: Tax Due is never written: the sheet's preprinted '0 0 0' is all that shows. The stored return has tax_due 2,679,876 and the sheet's own printed arithmetic implies 2,864,826 (Item 51 = 6,000,000 - 3,135,174). Verified by hand: Item 51 proves the engine computed a nonzero tax due that never reaches the comb.
Tax Rate prints only the preprinted '0%'; the screen stores tax_rate = 10.0. Value shown on screen is absent on paper (worse than blank: it reads as 0%).

12 attached rows entered on the screen (indices 5-16, sum 4,129,749) print nowhere: rows d-h map only to stored rows 0-4 and row i shows a separate 'OTHERS' figure (2,435,801). Rows past the printed lines are silently dropped - the SHARED-FINDINGS growable-capacity defect, confirmed on this form. Printed Item 18 total (21,704,926) therefore disagrees with the on-screen total (23,398,874).

Overflow rows collapse into a single 'OTHERS' line whose amount is only a partial sum: Schedule 2 shows 'OTHERS ... LEGAL BASIS REFERENCE 1' = 511,110 (sum of 4 of the 5 entered EXEMPT ACTIVITY rows; row 5's 155,555 is lost) and the printed total (511,110) differs from stored (666,665). Schedule 3 'OTHERS' rows print 113,330 / 283,319, which do not equal the sums of the entered rows, and the printed schedule totals differ from the stored data.
The 57-char name is clipped mid-word at the right edge ('...CONCEPCION DELA C' - 'RUZ' cut off) with no wrap or shrink.
The name wraps mid-word between comb lines ('JUANA M' / 'ARIA CONCEPCION DELA CRUZ'). Likely inherent to one-letter-per-box combs; noted, not counted as a fault.

defects.where: Form nav, Schedule 1 Item 17 attached rows
defects.what: Some attached rows show only the description in the row label (no amount) even though the amount is stored - cosmetic inconsistency in the list, data itself is intact.

entered_by_hand: Item 52 Regular Income Tax Otherwise Due = 5,000,000.00 typed on the Part V page; Schedule 1 Item 17 row 1 added through the real 'Add row' dialog (description + amount 887,654.32); Save pressed in the app.
open_questions: provenance names '1702-EX Jan 2018 ENCS v2.pdf'; it is not in hexuria/buwiz-forms-html and the BIR site did not yield it, so mac/official-p*.png are renders of html-frozen/1702ex-2018/index.html (the byte-frozen official sheet) instead.
notes: Whole-peso rounding of amount fields is by design on this sheet ('DO NOT enter Centavos'; writer-cells.json) and is not listed as a defect. WebKit 'Save as PDF' output matches the preview renders (pdf-pK vs print-pK); crops used for verification. Re-checked Items 18/40/41 and the dropped rows by hand before marking 'broken'.
